baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative entry, paired believing men and women, gardens, sub-surface rivers, permanence, and success form one spatial-temporal construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: A gender-complete believing cohort is transferred across a boundary into a planted enclosure whose lower plane carries abundant flow; permanence converts arrival into settled residence, and success names rescue joined to acquisition of the good.

activation_trace.role: Literal passage into an interior supplies the boundary-crossing transfer.
Security and trusted repose make the paired believers secured entrants as well as named recipients.
A tree-screened garden supplies the inhabited enclosure into which they pass.
Continuous streaming supplies motion within the otherwise stable destination.
The distinct lower direction places the flow beneath the inhabited layer.
Water channels cut through ground and make the lower flow materially abundant.
Persistence resistant to decay turns entry into durable habitation.
Rescue from harm plus obtaining good names the whole transfer as success.

changed_reading.before: A generic promise of heavenly reward for believers.
changed_reading.after: A designed transfer into an enduring, water-supported habitat where safety, possession of good, and residence are one mechanism.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second coordinated purpose covers their bad acts, after which the entire outcome is established 'with/at God' as immense success.
baseline_models.mechanism: Admission has a moral operation beside its spatial operation: bad acts are covered until their active claim is neutralized, while divine nearness, judgment, or standing supplies the evaluative court in which the combined outcome is great.

activation_trace.role: The explicit expiatory covering branch supplies neutralization of wrongdoing as if it no longer operated.
Moral ugliness and defect supply what the covering operation acts upon.
Presence, nearness, and rank in judgment supply the divine evaluative standpoint without requiring physical location.
Magnitude and force scale the integrated admission-and-covering result.

changed_reading.before: Gardens are the reward and forgiveness is an appended benefit.
changed_reading.after: Moral neutralization and spatial admission are coordinate operations, and their unity rather than the garden alone is the immense success.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Entry, gardens, covering, and lasting attachment each carry an interiorizing or sheltering branch inside the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can be read as nested protection: persons move inward, the garden conceals and shields, bad acts are screened, and the inhabitants adhere to the protected domain. The mechanism is not escape from visibility alone but controlled interiority around vulnerable moral selves.

activation_trace.role: The inward and secret aspect of entry supplies an interior layer beyond mere change of location.
Concealment from sense turns the garden boundary into a screen.
The protective shield branch gives that screen a defensive function.
General covering extends the shelter mechanism to the entrants' harmful record.
Adhesion and settled attachment keep the protected interior from being a temporary refuge.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes relocation to an attractive place.
changed_reading.after: The relocation builds layered, lasting shelter around both the persons and their exposed moral history.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Dense garden growth sits above opened watercourses whose running is paired with permanence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The stable garden is sustained by a moving lower substrate: channels open and widen below, their flow functions as continuing provision, and the vegetation thickens above. Permanence therefore need not mean stasis; it can mean an unbroken support process.

activation_trace.role: Entwined, vigorous vegetation supplies the living upper layer.
Continuing provision converts river motion into recurrent support rather than scenery.
The lower plane locates support beneath what it sustains.
Opening and widening until material can flow supplies the channel-forming process.
Durability makes the moving support process perennial.

changed_reading.before: Eternity freezes an already completed garden scene.
changed_reading.after: Eternity preserves a living infrastructure in which hidden flow continually sustains visible flourishing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening announced in 48:1 can be the aperture that makes both admission and irrigation possible: a closed threshold widens for entrants while a blocked outlet releases water. This makes the focus success the inhabited consequence of an opening, not merely a prize placed after a victory.

activation_trace.role: A closed thing opening into a widened entrance supplies the enabling threshold for the focus admission.
Water bursting from its outlet supplies the hydraulic side of the same aperture.
Literal entry receives the widened-threshold function in the focus.
Ground-cutting watercourses receive the released-water function.
Rescue and acquisition name what crossing the opened threshold accomplishes.

structural_cues: 48:1 repeats the opening root in verb and cognate object before 48:5 supplies entry and rivers.
The packet orders aperture before admission, while the focus itself locates moving water below the destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, entry, and water channels; I supply the arrow that one aperture enables both human passage and water release. A live alternative is that the opening is solely victory or adjudication and only thematically precedes the focus.

changed_reading.before: The announced opening and the promised gardens are successive but independent favors.
changed_reading.after: The opening is a threshold-and-outlet event whose widened access becomes the focus verse's admitted, irrigated habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding forgiveness root emphasizes a cover that protects the offender from an act's effects, while the focus uses an expiatory covering that neutralizes the bad acts themselves. The two covers coexist as person-directed shelter and record-directed cancellation rather than collapsing into a loose synonym pair.

activation_trace.role: A cover that also preserves supplies the protective outer operation around the person.
Covering fault while shielding its bearer from the effect specifies what the protective operation does.
The closing recurrence keeps person-protective forgiveness active at the far edge of the sequence.
The focus branch explicitly makes bad acts as though not done, supplying record-directed neutralization.
The entrants' ugly or defective acts are the material neutralized by the second cover.

structural_cues: The purpose clause of 48:2 uses forgiveness before 48:5 coordinates admission with expiatory covering.
Forgiveness returns in 48:29 beside a great wage, bracketing the focus's covering and great success.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two distinct covering roots and their branches; I assign protection of the bearer to one and neutralization of the record to the other. They may instead be rhetorical variation without a functional division.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and expiation are interchangeable labels for pardon.
changed_reading.after: The context activates a two-surface repair: the person is sheltered from consequences while the bad record is rendered non-operative.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, tranquility is delivered into the believers' hearts and makes an inner dwelling; the focus then moves those believers into an outer dwelling. The garden can therefore be the spatial completion of a settlement process already begun inwardly.

activation_trace.role: Delivering something downward to its recipient supplies the arrival of tranquility before human admission.
Inhabiting a dwelling converts tranquility from mood into inward settlement.
The heart supplies the interior site in which that first settlement occurs.
Entry externalizes the prior inward settlement as movement into a domain.
The enclosed garden supplies the outer dwelling corresponding to the settled heart.
Adhering to a place completes inward repose as lasting outward residence.

structural_cues: 48:4 places tranquility in hearts directly before 48:5 admits the same named believers into gardens.
The descent-tranquility-heart sequence recurs at 48:18 and 48:26, making inward settlement a repeated contextual process.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivered tranquility, hearts, believers, and later admission; I supply the inside-to-outside completion arrow. The live alternative is that tranquility equips action while the garden remains an unrelated later reward.

changed_reading.before: Garden entry begins only when the believers cross into the promised destination.
changed_reading.after: Admission completes a two-stage dwelling: tranquility first inhabits believers inwardly, then believers inhabit the garden outwardly.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns badness from a static item into a circuit: harmful construal becomes a surrounding, returning bad turn and terminates in a bad destination. Against that circuit, the focus covering can be read as interruption of the bad acts' capacity to keep circulating back upon their bearers.

activation_trace.role: Bad construal of others supplies the cognitive starting point of the negative circuit.
Rotation and surrounding give the bad turn its returning, enclosing geometry.
The specifically hated reversal or defeat supplies the circuit's adverse outcome.
What harms or grieves repeats across thought, surrounding turn, and destination, binding the circuit together.
Expiatory covering supplies the proposed interruption by making bad acts non-operative.

structural_cues: 48:6 follows immediately and repeats the badness root three times around a circular noun.
The focus assigns covering to believers, while 48:6 depicts unbroken badness returning upon its bearers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated badness and circular return; I infer that focus covering breaks rather than merely hides that circulation. The alternative is a simple contrast between pardon and punishment with no process-level feedback model.

changed_reading.before: Covering removes isolated entries from a moral ledger.
changed_reading.after: Covering disables a feedback loop in which bad construal and bad action otherwise close around the actor as bad outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge scene recasts great success as a completed relational transaction: allegiance is exchanged, a preserved covenant is fulfilled without deficit, and the resulting great wage can also carry an image of setting a crooked fracture. The focus outcome thus includes restored covenantal wholeness, not only possession of a reward.

activation_trace.role: A pledge of obedience supplies the binding relational exchange.
Completion without lack supplies the condition under which the exchange reaches wholeness.
A preserved covenant that secures its party supplies the durable bond being fulfilled.
Compensation for action supplies the overt outcome of covenant performance.
Setting a crooked fracture supplies a secondary repair image within that compensated outcome.
Obtaining good and escaping harm lets the focus success receive the covenant-completion mechanism.
The shared magnitude term links great success to the later great wage.

structural_cues: 48:10 moves from pledge through breach or fulfillment to a great wage.
Its 'great wage' formally echoes the focus's 'great success' while changing the outcome noun.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pledge, covenant, full performance, wage, and the shared adjective; I infer that the later sequence opens the internal mechanics of focus success and that the fracture branch colors moral repair. The wage may instead be a separate reward, and the fracture image may remain only exploratory.

changed_reading.before: Great success is an unstructured prize bestowed after belief.
changed_reading.after: Great success can also be covenant brought to fullness, with moral crookedness reset and faithful relation made whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: What humans cannot yet reach is already encompassed, preserved, and fully held. That activation changes the focus garden from merely future space into a reserved enclosure whose security precedes the entrants' capacity to access it.

activation_trace.role: Protective keeping supplies preservation of the not-yet-accessible outcome.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and possession makes the reservation already secure.
A protective enclosure supplies the form of the held destination.
Entry becomes later access to what is already encompassed and kept.

structural_cues: 48:21 explicitly contrasts present human inability with prior divine encompassing.
The focus uses causative admission rather than autonomous human arrival, matching access controlled by the holder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inability and divine encompassing; I read encompassing as reservation that protects an outcome until admission. It may instead denote mastery or exhaustive knowledge without implying a stored destination.

changed_reading.before: The promised garden becomes secure only when its recipients arrive.
changed_reading.after: Its protective perimeter and divine possession are already operative; entry grants access to a good held before humans can reach it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The blocked sanctuary sequence makes non-entry temporarily protective: immediate advance would trample unknown believing men and women and stain the advancing believers, so access is withheld while hidden groups remain intermixed; admission into mercy and eventual separation govern the delay. The focus promise therefore includes ethical sequencing that prevents new bad acts before covering old ones.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and turning away supply the concrete blocked access that must be interpreted.
Confinement and prevention make even the offering an object held short of its destination.
Security attaches to the concealed male and female believers whose protection justifies delayed access.
A foot physically treading a place supplies the accidental bodily harm the delay prevents.
Being smeared with evil supplies the moral contamination that would rebound from unknowing harm.
Repeated causative entry relocates the admission mechanism from gardens to mercy.
Tender mercy supplies the receiving domain into which protected persons are admitted.
Differentiation and separation supply the unrealized condition under which distinct treatment could proceed.
The focus covering of bad acts becomes the remedial counterpart to contextually preventing a fresh stain.

structural_cues: 48:25 repeats the focus's paired believing men and women and its causative entry construction.
Blocked approach, unknown intermixture, accidental treading, moral stain, entry into mercy, and hypothetical separation form one counterfactual chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every node of the counterfactual chain; I supply the arrow that temporary non-entry is protective mercy and that prevention complements later covering. A live alternative is a one-time strategic restraint that should not generalize to the focus promise's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Divine admission is best understood as immediate removal of barriers, with covering available after failure.
changed_reading.after: Merciful admission may require a controlled delay that protects hidden believers and prevents the entrants from acquiring the very stain the focus promises to cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later realized vision gives focus admission an embodied passage grammar: a promise is made true, entrants cross a barred threshold in security, carry visible completion marks, lack anticipatory fear, and receive a nearer opening. Great success can therefore include an assured but delayed safe crossing, not only the state after arrival.

activation_trace.role: Realizing a promise in action supplies assurance that delayed entry will become actual passage.
The same literal entry branch relocates the focus mechanism into a concrete sanctuary crossing.
Security and heart-rest specify the condition under which the crossing occurs.
Removal of hair supplies one visible bodily mark of completed rite after access.
Shortening rather than full removal supplies the coexisting alternative completion mark.
Expected-harm fear, explicitly negated, defines safe passage as more than physical access.
A nearer widened entrance supplies an intermediate opening on the way to promised entry.
The success/wilderness branch lets the focus outcome include surviving the dangerous interval before safe arrival.

structural_cues: 48:27 sequences verified vision, emphatic future entry, security, bodily rite, negated fear, and a near opening.
The entry and security roots directly recur from the focus while the earlier physical access has remained delayed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the passage sequence and repeated roots; I infer that it is a concrete analogue that opens the process inside focus success. The alternative is that sanctuary entry is a separate historical sign and garden entry remains wholly eschatological.

changed_reading.before: Success begins once believers are already inside the final destination.
changed_reading.after: Success also inhabits the assured crossing itself: delay, opened access, bodily completion, and freedom from expected harm are part of admission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing crop simile activates the focus garden's dense-growth branch and reverses the usual subject-object relation: believers are not only admitted into cultivated enclosure; as offshoots emerge, mutually reinforce, thicken, and stand on their stalks, the believing collective can itself become garden-like shelter and support. Destination and cultivated community can coexist without being identified.

activation_trace.role: Cultivation and growth supply the explicit organic process applied to the community.
Emergence from concealment supplies the transition from latent member to visible growth.
Offshoots arising around an original stalk supply plural expansion around a source.
Plants strengthening through mutual support supplies the causal link from plurality to resilience.
A body thickening after thinness supplies maturation into protective density.
Rising and stabilizing on support supplies achieved collective posture.
The supporting stalk supplies the load-bearing structure of the mature stand.
Dense, forceful plant growth anchors the community analogy back in the focus garden rather than letting it become an independent theme.
The believing cohort supplies the same human material that the closing simile cultivates.

structural_cues: 48:29 explicitly likens the community to a crop through a full emergence-support-thickening-standing sequence.
The crop sequence closes with belief, good work, forgiveness, and great wage, echoing the focus cohort, covering, and immense outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit community-crop simile and the focus supplies garden growth; I extend the analogy so cultivated believers can generate garden-like shelter for one another. The live alternative keeps the crop solely as a community portrait and the garden solely as their destination.

changed_reading.before: Believers are passive recipients placed inside an already complete garden.
changed_reading.after: Alongside that destination reading, believers can appear as cultivated participants whose emergence and mutual support produce a dense, stable, garden-like collective.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the success root's desert branch holds rescue and lethal waterlessness together, but it remains anchored in the focus's own success, rivers, protective garden, and entry. Render it only as a paradoxical crossing image, not as a replacement meaning for success or a claim that the garden is a desert.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places success after entry into a shielded garden with abundant water, allowing the dangerous-crossing branch to illuminate what has been escaped.

activation_trace.role: A wilderness poised between rescue and destruction supplies the hazardous interval inside the success image.
Abundant flowing water supplies the precise material reversal of a waterless crossing.
A protective shield supplies refuge at the far side of exposure.
Crossing inward supplies the endpoint of the hazardous passage.

changed_reading.before: Success is simply possession of the promised good.
changed_reading.after: Success can retain the memory of a lethal, waterless exposure crossed into flowing water and protection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is branch-distant twice over: the focus entry branch concerns thirsty camels returned to water, and the context dream root resolves non-dominantly to a watering root. It is still packet-licensed and anchored by entry plus rivers, but downstream prose should call it a material analogy and must never translate either the focus entry or the vision as watering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus causative entry stands beside rivers, while the later vision predicts secure entry and carries a packet-supplied split mapping to quenching and water conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Returning thirsty camels to a trough supplies the strange image of remedial or renewed admission to water.
The actual abundant watercourses keep the watering analogy visibly attached to the focus.
The split mapped branch of quenching rather than thirst makes the promised vision water-saturated at an exploratory level.
Bringing and carrying water supplies a conduit between the vision of entry and the focus rivers.
The later secure entry prevents the water image from floating free of the repeated admission construction.

changed_reading.before: Admission is a single juridical transfer into reward.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, admission resembles being brought again to sufficient water after deprivation, with the later vision carrying that replenishment forward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The womb-like model is surprising and cross-domain, yet it is doubly anchored by the focus garden root's fetus-in-belly branch and the later mercy root's womb branch, with concealed believers awaiting safe differentiation. It should be rendered as a gestational enclosure analogy only, never as literal rebirth doctrine or as an exhaustive account of the garden.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines inward entry and a concealing garden; 48:25 repeats entry into mercy while protected believers remain hidden in an undifferentiated population.

activation_trace.role: A fetus concealed in the belly supplies the focus-side gestational enclosure image.
Movement inward anchors the proposed holding phase in the focus construction.
The womb branch supplies a second packet-backed enclosure around admission into mercy.
Eventual separation and differentiation supply the exit condition from protected intermixture.
The concealed believing men and women supply the protected plurality held inside the analogy.

changed_reading.before: The garden is only a finished exterior destination after all differentiation is complete.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its concealment can also resemble a protected gestational interval that holds vulnerable plurality until safe differentiation and emergence.

strongest_changes: The opening becomes a single threshold-and-outlet mechanism enabling both admission and river flow.
Two covering roots separate protection of persons from neutralization of their harmful record.
Inward tranquility settling in hearts becomes the first phase of outward settlement in gardens.
Blocked access in 48:25 makes delayed non-entry a form of mercy that prevents harm to hidden believers and prevents a new moral stain.
The safe sanctuary entry and mature crop sequences preserve passage and collective cultivation as coexisting readings of the focus promise.
summary.what_was_special: The focus proved unusually productive as an architecture of controlled access: aperture, inward settlement, protective delay, safe crossing, moral covering, hidden water support, and collective plant growth all remained anchored in its entry-garden-flow construction. Split and distant branches added live water-return and gestational images without displacing the primary habitat reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from opening to irrigation, from inner tranquility to outer dwelling, and from covering to interruption of a badness circuit are reader-supplied rather than grammatically stated.
The divine encompassing in 48:21 may indicate mastery or knowledge rather than preservation of a reserved destination.
The covenant fracture-repair branch, desert-crossing branch, split vision-to-watering mapping, and womb analogy require explicit exploratory qualification.
The cultivated-community reading should coexist with, not absorb, the direct reading of gardens as the believers' destination.
The nearness branch of 'عند' may function as rank or judgment rather than relational proximity.
